text:
Booked through the Gowabi app for tartar removal and polishing.
It wasn't as painful as I expected, just slight sensitivity.
The dentist was gentle and gave good advice. The procedure took about 20 minutes. The place was clean and there's parking in front of the clinic. There's an additional 60 baht charge for sterilization.
I'll be back for a follow-up dental checkup.
